disciplinary_grounds.description: The board may suspend or cancel the license of any licensee for a repeated or serious violation of this act or the rules and regulations of the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may suspend or cancel the license of any licensee for a repeated or serious violation of this act or the rules and regulations of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A serious violation is any violation that poses a risk of injury or death to persons or is likely to result in property damage exceeding $2,500.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A serious violation is any violation that poses a risk of injury or death to persons or is likely to result in property damage exceeding two thousand five hundred dollars ($2,500.00).

disciplinary_grounds.description: A repeated violation is one that occurs within two years of any previously documented violation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A repeated violation is one that occurs within two (2) years of any previously documented violation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay a fine imposed by the department and upheld by the electrical board shall result in suspension of the electrical license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to pay the fine imposed by the department and upheld by the electrical board shall result in suspension of the electrical license until such time as the fine is paid in full.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Upon receipt of a court order to withhold, suspend or restrict a license, the chief electrical inspector shall notify the party and act in accordance with the court order.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Upon receipt from the department of family services of a certified copy of an order from a court to withhold, suspend or otherwise restrict a license issued by the chief electrical inspector, the chief electrical inspector shall notify the party named in the court order of the withholding, suspension or restriction of the license in accordance with the terms of the court order.
